headline: Breaking Down Amazon's Third-Quarter Earnings
importance_reason: other · 1 nguồn độc lập · có số liệu · 12 giờ tuổi
summary: Amazon spent more than $77 billion on property and equipment in the third quarter, far more than analysts’ estimates, while pursuing its effort to build data centers and fulfill demand for AI services. Anurag Rana and Poonam Goyal break down the numbers on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
